defects.what: The big project billboard in the centre is covered in several rows of scrawled pseudo-handwriting and fake signatures instead of being a blank sign.
Three rows of golden pseudo-letter glyphs are written across the left half of the notebook cover.
Three of the round puzzle stones (top left, right, bottom) carry anime children's faces, as if people were inside the stones.
The prayer wheels on both sides of the courtyard, most clearly the green and white ones at left, carry Latin-like pseudo-text labels.
The glowing dial segments at right show letter shapes such as "NE" and "MJII", and the hand and fingers are tattooed with rows of glyphs.
The dog at bottom right has no red kerchief, no white chest patch and two upright ears, so it does not read as Usman.
The stone dial at the bottom has Latin-like letters (E, B, C, D) around its rim instead of abstract carved marks.
The large face above the dial has loose spiky hair with no topknot and no red headband, so it does not read as Indio.
The man holding the dial has swept loose hair with no topknot and no headband, so it does not read as Indio.
The close-up face has loose hair with no topknot and no headband, so it does not read as Indio.
The back of the hand and fingers carry tattoo glyphs that look like CJK characters.
The carved stones on the floor show letter-like marks, e.g. "DE" on the centre stone.
The twelve carved marks on the stone dial look like Latin letters (T, U, N, X).
The left page of the open book at the left edge is filled with rows of pseudo-text.
Orange letters "NA" stand on the shelf behind Bea's left shoulder, and the background monitors show rows of text-like lines.
There is a letter-like glyph tattoo on Indio's neck, and pseudo-text sits in the corners of the hologram panel at top right.
Small pseudo-text labels appear at the top left of the lab screen and on the microscope base.
Usman has both ears fully upright, not his one folded ear.
